modules.title: 输入框空着、正在打字、只做占位——三种情况

items.title: 示范格式
items.text: 占位文字最好的用法是演示格式：日期框里灰色的「2026-03-12」、邮箱框里的 you@example.com，用户一眼知道该填成什么样。

items.title: 不承担说明职责
items.text: 一旦用户开始输入，占位就消失了。如果框是什么只写在占位里，填到一半就忘了——这个职责归标签。

items.title: 别把它当必填提示
items.text: 「必填」要靠标签旁的星号或明确文字；占位文字是灰色示例，用户经常跳过不读，不能承载规则。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 检查表单的口诀：输入之后还知道框里该填什么，说明标签在干活；只剩一片空白，说明只做了占位。另外占位文字颜色太浅会被当成禁用状态，跟 AI 说「占位文字保持可读的浅灰」。

lessonPractice.title: 用户开始在输入框里打字，下面哪个会消失？

options.label: 框里的灰色示例文字
options.feedback: 对。占位文字只是开场的示范，输入一开始就让位。所以它不能代替标签——不然输入之后用户就不知道框里该是什么了。

options.label: 输入框旁边的「邮箱」标签
options.feedback: 标签一直显示在框旁边，不随输入消失——这正是它和占位文字的分工。

options.label: 两个都不消失
options.feedback: 占位文字会在输入开始时消失；如果它没消失，反而是实现有问题的信号。

en.title: When the user starts typing, which of these disappears?

options.label: The gray example text inside the box
options.feedback: Correct. The placeholder yields the moment typing starts—which is why it cannot replace the label.

options.label: The "Email" label beside the box
options.feedback: The label stays beside the box through typing—that is exactly its job.

options.label: Neither disappears
options.feedback: The placeholder does disappear once typing begins; if it stays, the implementation is off.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 每个输入框都要有一直显示的标签；占位文字只用来示范格式，比如邮箱框里写 you@example.com。填完之后我仍然要能看清每个框是填什么的。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Give every input a permanently visible label; use placeholder text only to demonstrate format, like you@example.com in the email box. After filling in, I should still tell what each field is.

learning.assumes: You have typed into web inputs and seen gray example text inside them.
learning.outcome: You can separate the placeholder's job from the label's, and know "gray text disappears" is normal while "label disappears" is a bug.

items.title: Demonstrating format
items.text: The best placeholders show format: a gray 2026-03-12 in a date box or you@example.com in an email box tells the shape at a glance.

items.title: Not carrying explanations
items.text: The placeholder vanishes once typing starts. If the field's meaning lives only in the placeholder, it is forgotten halfway—that job belongs to the label.

items.title: Not a required marker
items.text: "Required" needs a star or explicit text by the label; users routinely skip gray example text, so rules cannot live there.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: The form-check mantra: if you still know what the field is after typing, the label is doing its job; if the box goes blank, the form was placeholder-only. Overly faint placeholders also read as disabled—ask for readable light gray.

distinctions.label: Label
distinctions.text: {c:label} stays beside the input the whole time; {c:placeholder} is the gray example inside that disappears once you type.

distinctions.label: Input
distinctions.text: {c:input} is the control you type into; {c:placeholder} is only the temporary hint shown inside it before typing.
